newsitem.title: USA: Conceptronic stake held by chairman.
newsitem.headline: Conceptronic stake held by chairman.

text.p: Rainer Bosselmann, chairman and chief executive officer of Conceptronic Inc said on Monday he acquired 666,670 Class A common shares, or 16.7 percent of outstanding Class A common stock.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bosselmann said the total amount held represents 11.7 percent of outstanding Class A common and common stock of the company.
Bosselmann said he bought the stake in the Portsmouth, New Hampshire company on November 25 for $2,000,010.

The shares of Class A common will be converted into shares of the company's common stock on May 26, 1997. At the company's option, under certain circumstances that conversion date may be extended for an additional two months, the filing said.
Conceptronic is a manufacturer of computer controlled capital equipment used in the electronic, surface mount technology circuit soldering industry.
